thread:
Jordan Kim: Hey team — got a ThinkPad from ops, trying to enroll in Intune and it's stuck at "DeviceCompliance". BitLocker is asking for a recovery key I don't have. Also company sites fail due to a cert error. Anyone available to help? I'm blocked from installing Docker.
Priya Desai: @Jordan Kim can you paste the device serial and the exact error from the BitLocker screen? Also try opening Edge and hitting https://intune.company.local and paste the cert error text.
Jordan Kim: Serial: R9L4X1Z
Jordan Kim: BitLocker prompt says: "No recovery key found for this device"; Edge shows "NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID" for https://intune.company.local
Carlos Mendez: Sounds like the corporate root CA isn't in the machine's trusted store. If Intune can't verify the profile, enroll will stall. Do you have access to an admin account on the laptop?
Jordan Kim: No admin, it's fresh OOBE. Can't install anything.
Carlos Mendez: OK — two paths: (1) IT gives you temporary local admin to import the CA, or (2) we use an already-signed provisioning package via the admin portal. I can open a ticket. @Mei Chen any bandwidth for a quick remote session?
Mei Chen: I can do 11:30am PT today. I'll need the device online and you on a camera for access. Jordan — can you confirm timezone and availability?
Jordan Kim: 11:30am PT works. Thanks!
Carlos Mendez: @IT Bot please create a ticket for "Intune enroll blocked — missing corporate CA + BitLocker recovery" for Jordan Kim, serial R9L4X1Z, priority P2.
IT Bot: Ticket created — INC-2026-2107. Assigned to it-ops oncall.
Mei Chen: Quick thing to try before session: open an admin PowerShell (if possible) and run:
```
certutil -store root
```
Look for "Redwood Corp Root CA" in the output. If it's missing, that's the cause.
Jordan Kim: I can't run admin PS. Will wait for session.
Mei Chen: Oncall says they'll give you temporary local admin for 30 minutes during the remote session. Please don't install extra software.
Jordan Kim: Remote session done — Mei imported the CA and re-ran enrollment. Intune accepted profile and BitLocker is now provisioning without prompting for a recovery key. Docker install succeeded. Thanks everyone :tada:
Priya Desai: Great — welcome aboard, Jordan! Ping if anything else blocks you.
Jordan Kim: Thanks y'all — appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
